items.title: He found a hidden beeping smoke alarm by making Claude triangulate it
items.why: Recorded the beep on phones around the house, fed the timestamps to Claude Code, and let it work out the source - no app, just math.

items.title: Willison's new pattern: let the coding agent run, sandbox what it touches
items.why: Agent stays on your machine, code runs in a WASM/QEMU/container jail with secrets outside - demos ship for Claude Code, Codex and Pi.

items.title: An ESP32-C5's built-in radio can now sniff out WiFi jamming itself
items.why: Uses the chip's own SDR to spot 2.4 and 5GHz interference and point at the jammer - work that used to need a spectrum analyzer.

items.title: A Linux KVM bug let a guest VM read 127GB of its host's own memory
items.why: A use-after-free on AMD hosts broke the wall between guest and host - virtualization isolation is leakier than it looks.

items.title: A pink-noise burst timed to your slow-wave sleep may boost brain cleanup
items.why: MIT/BU measured more cerebrospinal fluid flow when sound synced to slow waves - a drug-free lever on the brain's overnight waste clearance.

items.title: Binary search directly on an iterative segment tree, no recursion needed
items.why: Skips the usual recursive wrapper so range query plus binary search stays O(log n) and harder to get wrong under contest pressure.

items.title: Stop guessing at latency - bpftrace one-liners that show the real culprit
items.why: A handful of bpftrace commands trace syscalls and scheduler delays live, pointing straight at what's stalling a slow service.

items.title: A week of resistance training already shrank fat cells in mice
items.why: Early mouse work: fat cells released stored fat within 7 days of lifting, before any weight changed - encouraging, not shown in people yet.

items.title: Tata Sons' succession fight is colliding with an RBI-mandated IPO
items.why: Chandrasekaran and the Tata Trusts are at odds over control before a forced listing - a clean case study in succession vs governance.

items.title: India wants a homegrown GPU in two years, built on its own RISC-V cores
items.why: Betting on indigenous SHAKTI and VEGA chip designs over licensing ARM or x86 - an architecture bet, not just another funding headline.
